paytable.respins_desc:
It is a bonus game that consists of 3 respins and involves only the Bonus symbols. All the Bonus symbols that triggered the Bonus game stay in their cells during the following spins. 
Each Bonus symbol has its value. At the beginning of the bonus game, 3 multipliers (it can be ×2, ×3, ×4, ×5, ×10, or ×15) land in the empty cells. If during the spins Bonus symbols drop in these cells, the multipliers are applied to the symbols’ value. 
Each time a new Bonus symbol drops, the respin counter resets to 3.
The game ends when either all the cells are filled with Bonus symbols or when the spins run out.
paytable.progress_desc:
Progress bar helps to keep track of the number of Bonus symbols collected in the HOLD & WIN Bonus game. As new symbols appear, the indicator rises and displays the total number of Bonus symbols on the reels.
If 15 Bonus symbols drop on the reels, the winnings are multiplied by ×2. If 20 Bonus symbols are on the reels, the winnings are multiplied by ×3.
paytable.lines_title: Changing the number of win lines
paytable.lines_desc: The player can choose the number of win lines to play for each spin. There can be 20, 40, 60, 80 or 100 lines. The more lines the player chooses, the higher the minimum bet is.
